name: Kneeling Plank
steps: Kneel on the floor and set your forearms down with each elbow beneath its shoulder.
Slide your knees back until your head, hips and knees form a straight line.
Brace your abdomen and hold while breathing steadily, then bring your knees forward to finish.
tips: Keep your hips in line with your chest instead of sitting back toward your heels.
Look down between your forearms to keep your neck aligned with your back.
